finalText:
**One feature and eight fixes were real.**

The other 370-odd commits were dep bumps, refactors, and repeated boilerplate fixes.

| Area | What changed |
|---|---|
| Webhooks | Failed deliveries now retry with backoff |
| Auth | Expired tokens return 401, not 403 |
| DB | Request bodies no longer logged |
| HTTP | No more hangs or pool leaks on shutdown |
| Pagination | Null cursor no longer errors on lists |
| Various | Duplicate response header removed |
| Queue/jobs | Trailing slash trimmed once, not twice |
| Store/db/jobs | Empty allow-lists handled correctly |
| API | Trace ids survive retries |

No breaking changes this cycle.

Wrote it into [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md:3). Next: review before you cut 4.2.
